What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[We're Leaving (V)]]: left, the image of [[We're Leaving (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit e8445f0); right, the image of [[We're Leaving (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 6f23e07). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/wereleaving.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/wereleaving.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
